source_geometry_accounting.upstream_acceptance: Prior #503 evidence reassembled 362 mapped water/administrative features from the original Greenland PBF, matched all three GeoNames source rows, checked 19,102 archived polygons and recorded no historical transfer. This geography packet independently audits semantics and does not treat the producer checks as regional approval. The producer proposal pins baseline commit 1bbd4bdf9a95d8de9eead6aa8b080196ada51ff4; later main changed the pinned world-index/hierarchy. Its full preparation cannot be reproduced against current main using those old baseline hashes. This packet independently rechecks immutable source bytes, candidate geometry accounting, current OSM parent containment and scope, but does not claim that historical producer run is a current-main validation. PR #516 merged the source-restoration additions; both exact IDs are present in current data/world-index.json. Their regional semantic approval remains open.

bounded_follow_up_recommendations.work: Reconcile Disko's nine detached source fragments and its four non-abandoned GeoNames PPL labels (plus the Diskofjord/Kangerluk alternate-name record) plus Marraat's mapped dwelling status with a dated Greenland local place-name/settlement source; request or locate authoritative current municipal boundary data for Qeqertalik and Sermersooq; review Milne's 4.562% GSHHG/OSM residual. bounded_follow_up_recommendations.limits: No new location per coastline ring, island fragment, lake, village or old PPL row by quota; no outer-boundary change or historical transfer. Keep unknowns explicit if authoritative source coverage is unavailable.

bounded_follow_up_recommendations.work: Review the other Greenland descendants, complete named-island families and scale consistency, then coordinate any contradictions across affected neighbors.

decision: Both existing v5 whole-island locations have sourced named-island identity and modern-scale support, and the current mapped municipality relations fully contain each prepared dry-land candidate. Retain one current location per named island with the cited parent chains. Nine tiny detached Disko components, non-current-status settlement names, the older 2020 administrative remainder, source-vintage differences, and whole-family coverage are not fully resolved. No hierarchy, geometry, grid, certificate, live data or historical content change is proposed; this evidence does not approve the region or authorize imports.
